# FansFollow.me

> FansFollowMe is the global fitness and martial arts creator platform for subscriptions, coaching, direct fan access, and live creator discovery.

## About

FansFollow.me is a creator platform focused on fitness, bodybuilding, martial arts, and combat sports. Creators can monetize through subscriptions, pay-per-view content, live streaming, coaching, tipping, and merchandise. Fans get direct access to their favourite athletes and creators.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://fansfollowme.com/ — Platform overview, features, and creator discovery
- Explore Creators: https://fansfollowme.com/explore — Browse fitness and martial arts creators
- For Creators: https://fansfollowme.com/fans — Benefits for fans including direct fan access
- For Fans: https://fansfollowme.com/for-creators — Creator monetization tools (80%+ revenue)
- Celebrities: https://fansfollowme.com/celebrities — Featured champions and celebrity creators
- Casting: https://fansfollowme.com/casting — FFM Studios casting and content production
- Business: https://fansfollowme.com/business — Business partnerships and brand collaborations
- Support: https://fansfollowme.com/support — Help center and contact form
- FAQ: https://fansfollowme.com/faq — Frequently asked questions
- Blog: https://fansfollowme.com/blog — Latest news and creator stories

## Features

- 17+ revenue streams for creators
- Subscriptions and pay-per-view content
- Live streaming with private sessions
- Direct messaging between fans and creators
- Tipping and donations
- Group coaching and training programs
- Merchandise shop
- Crypto payments (BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL)
- Creator analytics dashboard
- Fan loyalty and rewards system

## Positioning

- Niche: Fitness, bodybuilding, martial arts, combat sports creators
- Tagline: "Where fans become friends"
- Differentiator: Brand-safe alternative to OnlyFans for fitness creators
- Revenue model: Creators keep 80%+ of revenue
